mapper.select: SELECT * from( /*SELECT t.contract_id, t.cashflow_id, t.times, t.cf_type, t.cf_item, t.due_date WRITE_OFF_DATE, t.due_amount WRITE_OFF_DUE_AMOUNT,t.principal WRITE_OFF_PRINCIPAL, t.interest WRITE_OFF_INTEREST, c.deposit_deduction FROM con_contract_cashflow t, con_contract c WHERE c.contract_id = t.contract_id AND c.data_class = 'NORMAL' AND t.times = 0 AND c.contract_status in ('INCEPT') AND t.CF_DIRECTION = 'INFLOW' AND t.cf_status = 'RELEASE' AND nvl(t.WRITE_OFF_FLAG, 'NOT') IN ('PARTIAL', 'NOT') AND nvl(t.RECEIVED_AMOUNT, 0) < t.DUE_AMOUNT and t.cf_item = 51 UNION ALL*/ SELECT t.contract_id, t.cashflow_id, t.times, t.cf_type, t.cf_item, t.due_date WRITE_OFF_DATE, t.due_amount-nvl(t.received_amount,0) WRITE_OFF_DUE_AMOUNT, t.principal-nvl(t.received_principal,0) WRITE_OFF_PRINCIPAL, t.interest-nvl(t.received_interest,0) WRITE_OFF_INTEREST, c.deposit_deduction FROM con_contract_cashflow t, con_contract c WHERE c.contract_id = t.contract_id AND c.data_class = 'NORMAL' AND t.times != 0 AND c.contract_status in ('INCEPT','ET') AND t.CF_DIRECTION = 'INFLOW' AND t.cf_status = 'RELEASE' AND nvl(t.WRITE_OFF_FLAG, 'NOT') IN ('PARTIAL', 'NOT') AND nvl(t.RECEIVED_AMOUNT, 0) < t.DUE_AMOUNT and exists(select 1 from prj_quotation_cashflow wc where wc.quotation_id = t.quotation_id and wc.cf_item = t.cf_item and wc.times = t.times and nvl(wc.deposit_deduction,0) = t.due_amount - nvl(t.RECEIVED_AMOUNT, 0) and c.lease_times = wc.times) and t.due_date = trunc(sysdate) ) tt order by tt.contract_id,tt.times

Select cc.contract_id/* funding_plan_id*/, cc.contract_number/* funding_plan_number*/, /*cc.contract_number payment_number, cc.contract_number funding_plan_id_n,*/ cc.company_id, cc.deposit_deduction, to_date(to_char(pq.LEASE_START_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyy-mm-dd') proposed_launch_date, pp.contract_number PP_CONTRACT_NUMBER, pp.contract_name PP_contract_name, /*(Select Sum(ccc.RECEIVED_AMOUNT) From con_contract_cashflow ccc Where ccc.contract_id In (Select ct.CONTRACT_ID From con_contract ct Where ct.PROJECT_ID = pp.project_id) And ccc.CF_ITEM = 0)*/nvl(t.received_amount,0) SUM_TOUFANG_AMOUNT, /*pq.LEASE_ITEM_AMOUNT*/t.due_amount-nvl(t.received_amount,0) LOAN_TOTAL_AMOUNT, pp.project_id project_id, (Select p1.PROJECT_NAME From prj_project p1 Where p1.PROJECT_ID = pp.REF_PROJECT_ID) PROJECT_NAME, /*(Select pq1.lease_item_amount From prj_quotation pq1 Where pq1.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_ID = pp.PROJECT_ID And pq1.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_CATEGORY = 'PRJ_PROJECT' And pq1.DATA_CLASS = 'VIRTUAL_CON')*/t.due_amount-nvl(t.received_amount,0) FINANCE_AMOUNT, (Select fou.unit_name From fnd_org_unit fou Where fou.unit_id = cc.unit_id) As unit_name, cc.unit_id, cc.tenant_id bp_id, (SELECT TT.BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM bp_bank_account_num FROM HLS_BP_MASTER_BANK_ACCOUNT TT WHERE TT.BP_ID=cc.tenant_id and rownum = 1) bp_bank_account_num, (SELECT TT.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME bp_bank_account_name FROM HLS_BP_MASTER_BANK_ACCOUNT TT WHERE TT.BP_ID=cc.tenant_id and rownum = 1) bp_bank_account_name, (SELECT TT.BANK_FULL_NAME bp_bank_branch_name FROM HLS_BP_MASTER_BANK_ACCOUNT TT WHERE TT.BP_ID=cc.tenant_id and rownum = 1) bp_bank_branch_name, (Select bp.BP_NAME From hls_bp_master bp Where bp.BP_ID = cc.tenant_id) BP_NAME, /*((Select pq1.lease_item_amount From prj_quotation pq1 Where pq1.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_ID = pp.PROJECT_ID And pq1.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_CATEGORY = 'PRJ_PROJECT' And pq1.DATA_CLASS = 'VIRTUAL_CON') - (Select Sum(ccc.RECEIVED_AMOUNT) From con_contract_cashflow ccc Where ccc.contract_id In (Select ct.CONTRACT_ID From con_contract ct Where ct.PROJECT_ID = pp.project_id) And ccc.CF_ITEM = 0))*/t.due_amount-nvl(t.received_amount,0) CONTRACT_BALANCE, pq.CURRENCY currency, (Select fc.currency_name From fnd_currency fc Where fc.currency_code = pq.CURRENCY) currency_id, (Select pq1.CURRENCY From prj_quotation pq1 Where pq1.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_ID = pp.PROJECT_ID And pq1.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_CATEGORY = 'PRJ_PROJECT' And pq1.DATA_CLASS = 'VIRTUAL_CON') CONTRACT_CURRENCY_ID, cc.contract_id, (Select fc.currency_name From fnd_currency fc Where fc.currency_code = (Select pq1.CURRENCY From prj_quotation pq1 Where pq1.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_ID = pp.PROJECT_ID And pq1.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_CATEGORY = 'PRJ_PROJECT' And pq1.DATA_CLASS = 'VIRTUAL_CON')) CONTRACT_currency, t.CASHFLOW_ID From con_contract cc, prj_project pp, prj_quotation pq,con_contract_cashflow t where pp.project_id = cc.project_id And pp.PROJECT_STATUS = 'APPROVED' And cc.QUOTATION_ID = pq.QUOTATION_ID
